name: ACKNOWLEDGE_AI_SIGNAL
text: not supported: the bots of the game program run no AI script

name: ACKNOWLEDGE_MULTIPLAYER_AI_SIGNAL
text: not supported: the bots of the game program run no AI script

name: ACTIVATE_TRIGGER
text: `scoreboard players set #<trigger> aoe_on 1` and the `schedule` of its timer (timer and area triggers: #2575)

name: ADD_TRAIN_LOCATION
text: `data modify storage aoe2mc:locations list append value "<player> <unit> <building> <button> <seconds>"`: the scenario mode of the game program adds the unit to the menu of the building of the player, at the button with the train time (#2865); the hotkey: not supported

name: AI_SCRIPT_GOAL
text: not supported: the bots of the game program run no AI script

name: ATTACK_MOVE
text: `tag` of the units in the area and an order in the storage `aoe2mc:orders`: the scenario mode of the game program gives them the aggressive stance and `aoe moveto` (#2647); vanilla has no walk-to command

name: BUILD_OBJECT
text: the order `build <player> <building> <x1> <y1> <x2> <y2>` in the storage `aoe2mc:orders`: the scenario mode of the game program completes the construction sites of the player in the area at once, with no villager work (`build.rise`, #2863)

name: CHANGE_CIVILIZATION_NAME
text: `data modify storage aoe2mc:names civs append value "<player> <name>"`: the scenario mode of the game program shows the name next to the player name in the player list and the diplomacy page (#2905); a name of the game files only (`string_id`): not supported

name: CHANGE_COLOR_MOOD
text: `time set` and `weather` of the mood (`MOODS`, `RAIN`; timer and area triggers: #1876); the fog stays

name: CHANGE_DIPLOMACY
text: `scoreboard players set #pN.pM aoe_dip`: the scenario mode of the game program changes the stance (#2645)

name: CHANGE_OBJECT_ARMOR
text: `execute as @e[tag=aoe2mc.pN,type=..,x=..,dx=..] run attribute @s minecraft:armor modifier add aoe2mc:trig_N_I V add_value` (add: V = N, subtract: V = -N, #2755); set: `modifier remove` of the earlier add and subtract effects, then `attribute @s minecraft:armor base set N` (#2909)

name: CHANGE_OBJECT_ATTACK
text: `execute as @e[tag=aoe2mc.pN,type=..,x=..,dx=..] run attribute @s minecraft:attack_damage modifier add aoe2mc:trig_N_I V add_value` for the attack classes 3 and 4 (add and subtract, #2755); set: `modifier remove` of the earlier add and subtract effects, then `attribute @s minecraft:attack_damage base set N` (#2909)

name: CHANGE_OBJECT_CAPTION
text: not supported: a text of the AoE2 interface only

name: CHANGE_OBJECT_CIVILIZATION_NAME
text: not supported: the game program shows no civilization name of a unit

name: CHANGE_OBJECT_COST
text: the cost in the storage `aoe2mc:costs`: the scenario mode of the game program uses it in the menus and when the player pays (#2776)

name: CHANGE_OBJECT_DESCRIPTION
text: not supported: a text of the AoE2 interface only

name: CHANGE_OBJECT_HP
text: `attribute ... minecraft:max_health base set N` (AoE2 hit points, 1 to 1024); add, subtract, multiply, divide: the function `hp/<op>_<N>` reads the base into the score #hp of aoe_hp and sets it with the macro `hp/apply` (#2693)

name: CHANGE_OBJECT_ICON
text: not supported: an icon of the AoE2 interface only

name: CHANGE_OBJECT_NAME
text: `execute as @e[tag=aoe2mc.pN,type=..,x=..,dx=..] run data modify entity @s CustomName.text set value "..."` (the player color stays, #2616)

name: CHANGE_OBJECT_PLAYER_COLOR
text: `execute as @e[tag=aoe2mc.pN,type=..,x=..,dx=..] run data modify entity @s CustomName.color set value "<color>"`: the name gets the hex color of the player color (`units.HEX`, as the converted names); the owner, the team and the glow stay (#2824)

name: CHANGE_OBJECT_PLAYER_NAME
text: not supported: the game program shows no player name of a unit

name: CHANGE_OBJECT_RANGE
text: `tag` of the units in the area and the order `range <tag> <operation> <quantity>` in the storage `aoe2mc:orders`: the scenario mode of the game program sends the new range of each tagged ranged unit with `aoe range` (#2767); vanilla has no shot range

name: CHANGE_OBJECT_SPEED
text: `attribute @e[..] minecraft:movement_speed base set V` of the units in the area and their mounts, V from the walk speed of the game program (game/ai.py, #2694)

name: CHANGE_OBJECT_STANCE
text: `tag` of the units in the area and an order in the storage `aoe2mc:orders`: the scenario mode of the game program sets the stance with `aoe stance` (#2705); vanilla has no stance

name: CHANGE_OBJECT_VISIBILITY
text: `effect give @s minecraft:invisibility infinite 0 true` (or `effect clear`) of the selected units, the units in the area and their mounts, and `CustomNameVisible` of the name tag; all players see it, Minecraft cannot hide an entity from one player only (#2862)

name: CHANGE_OWNERSHIP
text: `tag` `aoe2mc.pN` and `team join pN` of the units in the area and their mounts (timer and area triggers: #2570); to Gaia: the tag `aoe2mc.p0` and `team leave` (#2908); from Gaia: the tag `aoe2mc.p0` (#2916)

name: CHANGE_PLAYER_COLOR
text: `team modify pN color`: the chat color of the new player color (`units.TEAM_COLOR`) on the names and the glow of the units; the wool of the sheep and the banners keep the old color (#2712)

name: CHANGE_PLAYER_NAME
text: `team modify pN displayName {"text": "..."}`: the sidebar and the tab list (#2711)

name: CHANGE_TECHNOLOGY_COST
text: the cost of the technology in the storage `aoe2mc:costs`: the scenario mode of the game program uses it in the menus and when the player pays (#2819)

name: CHANGE_TECHNOLOGY_DESCRIPTION
text: not supported: a text of the AoE2 interface only

name: CHANGE_TECHNOLOGY_HOTKEY
text: not supported: Minecraft has no hotkeys of the menus

name: CHANGE_TECHNOLOGY_ICON
text: not supported: an icon of the AoE2 interface only

name: CHANGE_TECHNOLOGY_LOCATION
text: `data modify storage aoe2mc:places list append value "<player> <technology> <building> <button>"`: the scenario mode of the game program moves the item to the menu of the building, at the slot of the AoE2 button (#2864)

name: CHANGE_TECHNOLOGY_NAME
text: `data modify storage aoe2mc:names list append value "<player> <technology> <name>"`: the scenario mode of the game program shows the name in the menus of the player (#2821); a name of the game files only (`string_id`): not supported

name: CHANGE_TECHNOLOGY_RESEARCH_TIME
text: the time in the storage `aoe2mc:times`: the scenario mode of the game program uses it when the player researches the technology (`train.seconds`, #2820)

name: CHANGE_TRAIN_LOCATION
text: `data modify storage aoe2mc:places list append value "<player> <unit> <building> <button>"`: the scenario mode of the game program moves the item to the menu of the building, at the slot of the AoE2 button (#2864)

name: CHANGE_VARIABLE
text: `scoreboard players set`, `add`, `remove` or `operation` on `#vN aoe_var` (#2611)

name: CHANGE_VIEW
text: `tp @a[team=pN] x y z` to the tile, on the ground (the player is the camera, #2610)

name: CLEAR_INSTRUCTIONS
text: `title @a clear` (#2609)

name: CLEAR_TIMER
text: `bossbar remove aoe2mc:timerN` and `schedule clear aoe2mc:timer/N` of the slot N (#2696)

name: COUNT_UNITS_INTO_VARIABLE
text: `execute store result score #vN aoe_var if entity @e[tag=aoe2mc.pM,type=..,x=..,dx=..]`: the number of units of the player in the area, no area: the whole map (#2697)

name: CREATE_DECISION
text: `scoreboard players enable @a aoe_decision` (a `trigger` objective) and `tellraw @a` with the question and two options; a click runs `/trigger aoe_decision set <id × 10 + option>`, the tick function keeps it in `#last` (#2886); only string IDs: not supported yet

name: CREATE_GARRISONED_OBJECT
text: `summon` of the unit (`units.make_entity()`) in the state of a garrisoned unit (`Invulnerable`, `NoAI`, tags `aoe2mc.garrisoned`, `aoe2mc.made_inside`) on the inside cells of each selected building; the game program adds it to the garrison (#2764); a ship or ram holder: not supported yet

name: CREATE_OBJECT
text: `summon` of the entity of `units.make_entity()` (units, timer triggers: #656); a building: the order `create` of the scenario mode, a complete building (#2911)

name: CREATE_OBJECT_ARMOR
text: the change "N NAME melee 2 V" or "N NAME pierce 2 V" in the storage `aoe2mc:attributes` (an add, as AoE2 adds the entries of one class): the scenario mode of the game program adds V to the melee or pierce armor of the unit type of the player (`train.stats`, #2855); the other armor classes are not supported

name: CREATE_OBJECT_ATTACK
text: the change "N NAME attack 2 V" in the storage `aoe2mc:attributes` for the attack classes 3 and 4: the scenario mode of the game program adds V to the attack of the unit type of the player (`train.stats`, #2855); the bonus classes are not supported

name: DAMAGE_OBJECT
text: `execute as @e[tag=aoe2mc.pN,type=..,x=..,dx=..] run damage @s N` (N in AoE2 hit points; timer and area triggers: #2571); a negative N heals with the commands of `HEAL_OBJECT` (#2907); a building: not supported yet

name: DEACTIVATE_TRIGGER
text: `scoreboard players set #<trigger> aoe_on 0` and `schedule clear` of its timer (#2575)

name: DECLARE_VICTORY
text: `scoreboard players set #pN aoe_win 1`: the scenario mode of the game program ends the game (#2542)

name: DELETE_KEY
text: `data remove storage aoe2mc:keys values."<key>"` (#2887); the keys stay only in the world, not between the scenarios of a campaign

name: DISABLE_OBJECT_DELETION
text: not supported: the game program has no delete order

name: DISABLE_OBJECT_SELECTION
text: `tag @e[..] add aoe2mc.unselectable` of the units of the player in the area: no click, selection box or double click of the game program selects them (#2854)

name: DISABLE_TECHNOLOGY_STACKING
text: `data modify storage aoe2mc:menus list append value "<player> <technology> stack 1"`: the scenario mode of the game program lets the player research it once again (#2866)

name: DISABLE_UNIT_ATTACKABLE
text: `data merge entity @s {Invulnerable:1b}` of the units of the player in the area (#2695)

name: DISABLE_UNIT_TARGETING
text: `tag @e[..] add aoe2mc.notarget` of the units of the player in the area: no unit or tower chooses them as a target, an attack order still hits (#2826)

name: DISPLAY_INSTRUCTIONS
text: `title @a actionbar` (short text) or `title @a subtitle`

name: DISPLAY_TIMER
text: `bossbar` aoe2mc:timerN and a `schedule function` each second with the time left (timer and area triggers: #2572)

name: ENABLE_DISABLE_OBJECT
text: the item in the storage `aoe2mc:menus`: the scenario mode of the game program shows or hides it in the menus of the player (#2775)

name: ENABLE_DISABLE_TECHNOLOGY
text: the technology in the storage `aoe2mc:menus`: the scenario mode of the game program shows or hides it in the menus of the player (#2775)

name: ENABLE_OBJECT_DELETION
text: not supported: the game program has no delete order

name: ENABLE_OBJECT_SELECTION
text: `tag @e[..] remove aoe2mc.unselectable` of the units of the player in the area (#2854)

name: ENABLE_TECHNOLOGY_STACKING
text: `data modify storage aoe2mc:menus list append value "<player> <technology> stack <n>"`: the scenario mode of the game program lets the player research it n times, the effects stack (#2866)

name: ENABLE_UNIT_ATTACKABLE
text: `data merge entity @s {Invulnerable:0b}` of the units in the area, not the garrisoned ones (#2695)

name: ENABLE_UNIT_TARGETING
text: `tag @e[..] remove aoe2mc.notarget` of the units of the player in the area (#2826)

name: FREEZE_OBJECT
text: `data merge entity @s {NoAI:1b}` of the units in the area and their mounts (#2608)

name: HEAL_OBJECT
text: `execute as @e[tag=aoe2mc.pN,type=..,x=..,dx=..] store result score` of Health and max_health, `scoreboard players add`, then `store result entity @s Health` (AoE2 hit points, not above the maximum, #2692)

name: INITIATE_RESEARCH
text: the order `research <ref> <technology>` in the storage `aoe2mc:orders`: the scenario mode of the game program starts it at the selected building as a click of its menu, and the player pays (#2772)

name: KILL_OBJECT
text: `kill @e[tag=aoe2mc.pN,type=..,x=..,y=..,z=..,dx=..,dy=..,dz=..]`, no area: the whole map (#2568)

name: LOAD_KEY_VALUE
text: `scoreboard players set #vN aoe_var <quantity>`, then `execute if data storage aoe2mc:keys values."<key>" store result score #vN aoe_var run data get ...` (#2887); the keys stay only in the world, not between the scenarios of a campaign

name: LOCK_GATE
text: the order `lock <ref>` in the storage `aoe2mc:orders`: the scenario mode of the game program puts the portcullis on the gate and locks it with `aoe gate lock X Z` (the bars stay down, #2762)

name: MIRROR_DIPLOMACY
text: `scoreboard players set #mN.pM aoe_dip`: the scenario mode of the game program gives player N the stances of player M toward each other player (#2822)

name: MODIFY_ATTRIBUTE
text: the change in the storage `aoe2mc:attributes`: the scenario mode of the game program changes the hit points, attack, melee and pierce armor, range or reload of the unit type of the player (`train.stats`, #2763); the other attributes are not supported

name: MODIFY_ATTRIBUTE_BY_VARIABLE
text: the score `#vN aoe_var` goes with `execute store result storage` and a macro function into the line of the storage `aoe2mc:attributes`; the scenario mode of the game program changes the values as for Modify Attribute (#2856)

name: MODIFY_ATTRIBUTE_FOR_CLASS
text: one change for the class `@<ObjectClass>` in the storage `aoe2mc:attributes`: the scenario mode of the game program changes the values of each unit type of the class (`train.applies`, `train.CLASSES`: archer, cavalry, cavalry archer, hand cannoneer, infantry, siege weapon, spearman, war elephant, warship; #2859); the other classes are not supported

name: MODIFY_OBJECT_ATTRIBUTE
text: the commands of the effect of the attribute on the units of the player in the area: hit points as Change Object HP, a set of the speed as Change Object Speed, armor and attack as Change Object Armor and Attack (`attribute ... modifier add`); another attribute: not supported (#2860)

name: MODIFY_OBJECT_ATTRIBUTE_BY_VARIABLE
text: the units of the player in the area: hit points by `scoreboard players operation #hp aoe_hp += #vN aoe_var` (or `=`, `-=`, `*=`, `/=`) on the base and the macro `hp/apply`; armor and attack, add or subtract: `execute store result storage` of the score and the macro `attribute ... modifier add $(id) $(value) add_value`; another attribute, a set of armor or attack, and the speed: not supported (#2861)

name: MODIFY_RESOURCE
text: `scoreboard players add`/`remove` on `#pN.<resource> aoe_res`, a set on `aoe_set`; the game program puts it into the stock (`--mode scenario`: `scenario.resources`, #2576)

name: MODIFY_RESOURCE_BY_VARIABLE
text:
`scoreboard players operation #pN. aoe_res += or -= #vM aoe_var`, a set is `operation = #vM aoe_var` on `aoe_set`; multiply and divide (`*=`, `/=`) of a copy of the stock of the game program (`Food aoe_res

`) with the pending change, then a set (#2768, #2941)

name: MODIFY_VARIABLE_BY_ATTRIBUTE
text: the request in the storage `aoe2mc:reads`: the scenario mode of the game program runs `scoreboard players operation #vN aoe_var = #read aoe_var` (or `+=`, `-=`, `*=`, `/=`) with the hit points, attack, melee and pierce armor, range or reload of the unit type of the player (`train.stats`, #2858)

name: MODIFY_VARIABLE_BY_RESOURCE
text: `scoreboard players operation #vN aoe_var = Gold aoe_resP` (or `+=`, `-=`, `*=`, `/=`): the stock of the game program, `aoe_res` for player 1 (#2823)

name: MODIFY_VARIABLE_BY_VARIABLE
text: `scoreboard players operation #vA aoe_var = #vB aoe_var` (or `+=`, `-=`, `*=`, `/=`, #2713); a division by 0 leaves the score as it is (Minecraft; the AoE2 wiki has no page on it)

name: PATROL
text: `tag` of the units in the area and an order in the storage `aoe2mc:orders`: the scenario mode of the game program walks them with `aoe moveto` (#2647); vanilla has no walk-to command

name: PLACE_FOUNDATION
text: the order `found <player> <building> <x> <y>` in the storage `aoe2mc:orders`: the scenario mode of the game program puts the construction site of the building for free at the tile when the place is free (`build.found`, #2825)

name: PLAY_SOUND
text: `playsound` of the vanilla sound of the name part (`data/sounds.jsonl`), at the tile or at each player (#2644)

name: REMOVE_OBJECT
text: `kill @e[tag=aoe2mc.pN,type=..,x=..,y=..,z=..,dx=..,dy=..,dz=..]` (timer triggers: #656)

name: REPLACE_OBJECT
text: `tag` of the old units, `execute at` each one `run summon` of the new entity of the target player (`units.make_entity()`), then `kill` of the old units and their mounts (#2703); buildings: not supported yet

name: RESEARCH_LOCAL_TECHNOLOGY
text: not supported: Chronicles only, the game program has no local technologies

name: RESEARCH_TECHNOLOGY
text: `scoreboard players set #rN.I aoe_tech 1`: the scenario mode of the game program gives the technology (#2577)

name: SCRIPT_CALL
text: not supported: no XS scripts

name: SEND_CHAT
text: `tellraw @a[team=pN] {"text": ...}`

name: SET_BUILDING_GATHER_POINT
text: the order `rally <player> <ref> <x> <y>` of each selected building (or `rally <player> <name> <x> <y> <area>` for the buildings of the type in the area) in the storage `aoe2mc:orders`: the scenario mode of the game program sets the rally point (`train.rally`), and the new units walk to the tile (#2853)

name: SET_OBJECT_COST
text: the one resource of the cost in the storage `aoe2mc:costs` (a `+` in front of the resource): the scenario mode of the game program keeps the other resources of the cost (#2857)

name: SET_PLAYER_VISIBILITY
text: `scoreboard players set #pN.pM aoe_vis`: the scenario mode of the game program shows the units of player M to player N out of sight, or hides them again (`fog.py`, #2774)

name: STOP_OBJECT
text: `tag` of the units in the area and the order `stop <tag>` in the storage `aoe2mc:orders`: the scenario mode of the game program stops them with `aoe stop` and ends their patrols (#2754); vanilla has no stop of a walk order

name: STORE_KEY_VALUE
text: `execute store result storage aoe2mc:keys values."<key>" int 1 run scoreboard players get #vN aoe_var` (#2887); AoE2 keeps the keys between the scenarios of a campaign, a converted world keeps them only in the world

name: TASK_OBJECT
text: `tag @e[tag=aoe2mc.pN,x=..,dx=..] add aoe_taskK` and the tile in the storage `aoe2mc:tasks`: the scenario mode of the game program walks them there with `aoe moveto` (vanilla has no walk-to command, #2646)

name: TELEPORT_OBJECT
text: `tp @e[tag=aoe2mc.pN,x=..,dx=..] x y z` and the mounts of the riders (#2569)

name: TRAIN_UNIT
text: the order `train <ref> <unit> <quantity>` in the storage `aoe2mc:orders`: the scenario mode of the game program queues the units at the selected building as clicks of its menu, and the player pays (#2772)

name: TRIBUTE
text: `scoreboard players add`/`remove` on `#pN.<resource> aoe_res`; the game program puts it into the stock (`--mode scenario`: `scenario.resources`, #2576)

name: UNLOAD
text: the order `unload <player> <ref>` of each selected building (or each building in the area) in the storage `aoe2mc:orders`: the scenario mode of the game program lets its garrison out and walks it to the tile with `aoe moveto` (#2773); a ship or ram holder: not supported yet

name: UNLOCK_GATE
text: the order `unlock <ref>` in the storage `aoe2mc:orders`: the scenario mode of the game program unlocks the gate with `aoe gate unlock X Z` (#2762)

name: USE_ADVANCED_BUTTONS
text: not supported: a setting of the AoE2 interface only
